children: Adial Pharmaceuticals adjourned votes on Proposals 3–6 at its 2026 Annual Meeting while awaiting Nasdaq approval of its listing application.
Reconvened meeting Oct. 15 but further adjourned Proposals 3–6 because Nasdaq approval was still pending.
Polls for Proposals 3–6 remain open; meeting will reconvene Oct. 26 at 8:30 a.m. ET in Charlottesville.
Proposals 1,2,7,8,9,10,11,12 were voted on Sept. 17 as Nasdaq approval was not required for those items.
Record date remains Aug. 17; previously submitted proxies for Proposals 3–6 remain effective unless changed.

title: Adial Pharmaceuticals adjourns votes on Nasdaq-dependent proposals, reconvenes meeting Oct. 26
